cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import subprocess, time, random, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp/t')
E='/workspace/tmp/t/engine'
from stress_native import random_layout, h
import image as img
rng=random.Random(4)
R=64
starts=[0]+sorted({rng.randrange(1,1<<128) for _ in range(R-1)})
hops=[rng.randrange(0,2**31-1) for _ in range(R)]
# maximum node count tree: binary split into 64 leaves -> N = 127
def rec(lo,span):
    if span==1: return ('leaf',lo,span,())
    a=span//2
    return ('node',lo,span,(rec(lo,a),rec(lo+a,span-a)))
tree=rec(0,R)
order=[tree]; head=0
while head<len(order):
    nd=order[head]; head+=1; order.extend(nd[3])
pos={id(nd):i for i,nd in enumerate(order)}
layout=[]
for nd in order:
    kind,lo,span,kids=nd
    if kind=='leaf': layout.append((1,0,0,lo,span,()))
    else: layout.append((0,0,0,lo,span,tuple(pos[id(k)] for k in kids)))
print('nodes',len(layout),'max allowed',2*R-1)
A=8192
addrs=[rng.randrange(0,1<<128) for _ in range(A)]
lines=['PACK %d %d %d'%(R,len(layout),A)]
lines+=['%s %d'%(h(starts[i]),hops[i]) for i in range(R)]
for kind,mode,cached,lo,span,kids in layout:
    lines.append('%d %d %d %d %d %s'%(lo,span,mode,cached,len(kids),' '.join(map(str,kids))))
lines+=[h(a) for a in addrs]
data=('\n'.join(lines)+'\n').encode()
print('input MiB %.2f'%(len(data)/2**20))
t=time.time(); p=subprocess.run([E],input=data,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE); dt=time.time()-t
print('rc',p.returncode,'time %.2f'%dt,'out MiB %.2f'%(len(p.stdout)/2**20), p.stderr.decode()[:200])
toks=p.stdout.decode().split('\n')
py=img.build(R,starts,hops,layout)
print('image match', toks[0]==py.hex, 'len', len(toks[0]))
ok=True
for i,a in enumerate(addrs):
    row=toks[1+i].split()
    r=int(row[1]); path=[int(x) for x in row[3:]]
    pr,pp=img.lookup(py,a)
    if (r,path)!=(pr,pp): ok=False; print('mismatch at',i); break
print('answers match', ok, 'rows', len([t for t in toks if t.strip()])-1)
# TRACE round trip
t=time.time()
p2=subprocess.run([E],input=('TRACE %d\n%s\n'%(A,py.hex))+'\n'.join(h(a) for a in addrs)+'\n',stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
print('trace rc',p2.returncode,'time %.2f'%(time.time()-t),'same as pack:', p2.stdout.decode().split('\n')==toks[:1+A]+[''] if False else [x for x in p2.stdout.decode().split('\n') if x.strip()]==[x for x in toks[1:1+A] if x.strip()])
PYEOF
